Kobold_Inventor
Koll the Red is a Kobold trader found in the Watch Citadel, an area within the Upper City accessible after travelling to the Morphic Pool.
“
Bodies, bloods - this is the dream! Knew I was smarts to sneaks in. The skelly boy said I could stay if I solds ya stuff. So hurry up - BUY, BUY BUY.
„
— Koll (kobold)

Involvement

Koll is the final trader encountered in the game. He is adamant that the party succeed in battle, lest he lose a customer.

The table next to Koll is covered in various magical equipment and consumables. Taking these items counts as stealing and causes Koll to permanently vanish in a cloud of smoke along with the remaining items on the table. This also causes  Beorn Wunterbrood and any nearby characters gathered as part of the ⁠Gather Your Allies quest to become hostile - preventing the party from using their  Gather Your Allies abilities.[1]

Store

  •  Potion of Angelic Reprieve
  •  Potion of Angelic Slumber
  •  Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
  •  Scroll of Revivify

Notes

  1. ↑ If leaving through the door leading to the final battle, walking a short distance away, and waiting a short time, then the allies leave the room. Then the party can kill Koll and steal any items that they wish from the table. This also turns Beorn hostile but he poses little threat to an end-game party.
